verdict.rationale: Clerk ships official SDKs: the clerk/javascript GitHub repo, a docs page on pinning a Clerk SDK version, and a Next.js integration that community users praise. Its official MCP server also gives AI agents up-to-date SDK snippets, which suits AI-native use. Hands-on feedback, however, reports heavy transitive dependencies and hard-to-debug library code. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported SDK languages/frameworks with reference docs, and independent corroboration of SDK quality beyond Next.js (current feedback reports dependency bloat and obfuscated code).
